task.title: Scaling up the Red Hat Quay deployment after restore
task.shortdesc: To scale up your Red Hat Quay deployment, you can re-enable auto scaling and remove replica overrides. This restores your registry to normal operation after scaling down.

step.cmd: Scale up the Red Hat Quay deployment by re-enabling auto scaling, if desired, and removing the replica overrides for Quay, mirror workers and Clair as applicable. For example:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: quay.redhat.com/v1 kind: QuayRegistry metadata: name: registry namespace: ns spec: components: … - kind: horizontalpodautoscaler managed: true - kind: quay managed: true - kind: clair managed: true - kind: mirror managed: true …

dlentry.dd: Specifies re-enabling auto scaling of Red Hat Quay, Clair and mirroring workers again.
Specifies that replica overrides are removed again to scale the Red Hat Quay components back up.
